pages.title: Strange Matter Pellet
pages.text: Quark matter made of up, down and strange quarks in roughly equal numbers. Some physicists suspect it is more stable than ordinary nuclei, which would make it contagious: ordinary matter that touches it may convert. The pellet is heavy, faintly warm and sits in a container I never open twice.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Fractured Essence from a Destabilised Husk keeps some strange quarks in its splinters. A Maxwell's Demon Sorter, cooled by superfluid helium, sorted those quarks from the rest one at a time until a pellet of pure strange matter remained.
